changelog: Initial release: standardized grading prompt for grades 3-6 English written homework
summary: Standardized grading and feedback prompt for grading elementary school English written homework (grades 3-6). Use when the user asks to check, grade, correct, review, or mark English homework, writing assignments, compositions, fill-in-the-blank, sentence rewriting, translation, or any written English exercises from Chinese primary school students in grades 3 through 6. Triggers on phrases like '批改英语作业', '改英语作文', 'check English homework', 'grade English writing', '批改作业', '英语书面作业批改', '小学英语批改', '改错', 'check my English'.
